rules.statement: The COL1A1 missense change Arg134Cys has been reported in an EDS/OI overlap phenotype.

sources.quote: EDS/OI overlap phenotypes (OMIM 619115) Three arginine-to-cysteine changes (Arg134Cys, Arg915Cys, & Arg396Cys) in COL1A1 have been reported in an EDS phenotype w/a propensity to arterial rupture in early adulthood [Malfait et al 2007].
